discovery.abstract: Machine-readable/modeling artifact for a 13-element planar K-Field thruster consisting of twelve ring elements plus a large top face. It organizes the device geometry, ICRS-oriented element states, force/torque calculations, full 6-DOF rigid-body dynamics, and steering-control simulation outputs.
